title: JobMeta
description: C-7 `meta.json` of a job handle. Written by the adapter's JobHost before the spawn; recovery invariants J1–J6 are in recovery.md. Read by the tool, Watch target kind `job`, recovery, and `vibe stop`. Persisted shape.

response_id.description: `messages.id` of the committed response that made the call. With `session_id`, `response_seq`, and `tool_call_id`, the call instance that started the job (`CallInstance`, `ToolContext.call`): providers reuse call ids, so T2's job lookup, J5's settled check, and the hand-over's owning Turn match a job to its call by the whole instance, never by time.

response_seq.description: That response's `context_seq` in `session_id`. The call's result is the first `tool_result` with its id after it, in context order.

created_at.description: UTC creation time, from which a job Watch reports the elapsed time. Never compared with a row's time: the wall clock can step back.

state_dir.description: Absolute job directory holding output.log and exit.

process.description: The identity fields of PersistedProcessIdentity (core/process_isolation.py) plus the process group, recorded before the command can run (J2).

terminal.description: Reserved for the `pty` backend; null for `pipe`.

deadline_at.description: Absolute time at which the job's process tree is killed (from `timeout`); enforced by whichever component owns the job (J3).
